hook.text: Breakfast is the most important meal? That's a marketing lie. Here's the truth.
queries: person looking at breakfast plate confused

tips.text: First, the breakfast rule was invented by cereal companies in the 1940s. Kellogg's wanted to sell more boxes. So they paid scientists to call breakfast essential. It was never about your health.
queries: vintage cereal box advertisement old style
old magazine ad breakfast cereal retro
kelloggs corn flakes vintage box closeup

tips.text: Second, your body burns fat in the morning. After eight hours of fasting, your insulin is low. Eating breakfast spikes it. Fat-burning stops immediately. So you store more fat all day.
Third, skipping breakfast improves focus. Without a heavy meal, your brain stays sharp. Studies show people who skip breakfast think faster and concentrate longer than those who eat early.

cta.text: Try skipping breakfast for one week. Just water and black coffee. See how you feel. Follow for more health myths busted.
